explanation: Workers dig the tunnels and gather food while the queen and a few males breed. With almost no fur, they huddle together to keep warm in their burrows.

claims.text: Naked mole-rats are nearly hairless African rodents that live underground in colonies with a single breeding female, the queen.
Gerbils, springhares and crested porcupines do not live in colonies with a breeding queen.
In naked mole-rat colonies, workers dig tunnels and gather food while the queen breeds with a few males.
Naked mole-rats huddle together to keep warm because they regulate their body temperature poorly.
